name: Triangle Type
source:
In the morning, I was woken up by birds' song in a hotel.

Right next to me on a bed is a flashy girl Mayuu Takehara.

Spending a night together, we are getting into a deeper relationship.

Along with it, another major change comes to my relationship with Chiaki Makabe.

My high school life would be dangerous!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE232971.html]DLsite English[/url]]
